question: Which one of the following country assisted India to launch its first artificial Satellite in year 1975?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soviet Union**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first artificial satellite, named Aryabhata, was launched with the assistance of the **Soviet Union** in 1975.
 
• The satellite was named after the famous ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer, Aryabhata.
 
• The launch took place on April 19, 1975, and marked a significant milestone in India's space program.
 
• The satellite was launched from the Kapustin Yar launch site using a Soviet Kosmos-3M launch vehicle.
 
• This collaboration laid the foundation for future advancements in India's space technology and exploration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Soviet Union played a crucial role in supporting emerging space programs in various countries during the 20th century.
 
• India's space program has since grown significantly and now includes missions to the Moon and Mars, as well as a robust satellite launch capability.
 
• The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency responsible for India's space missions and has become one of the leading space agencies in the world.
 
• ISRO's achievements include the successful Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) and the Chandrayaan missions to the Moon.
 
• International cooperation remains a key aspect of space exploration, with India collaborating with various countries and organizations to advance space science and technology.
